---
title: "imprint Quarto CI smoke test"
subtitle: "A render that must always succeed"
description: "The Quarto twin of ci-fixture.md — exercises the imprint-typst format without Mermaid, so CI needs no headless Chromium."
author: "CI"
# `docdate` is the canonical key — it reaches the cover verbatim. Quarto would
# reformat a bare `date`, and the CLI's ci-fixture.md covers the `date` alias.
docdate: "2026"
category: "Test"
footer_text: "imprint CI"
cover: true
# With its '#': the Lua filter strips it before the template writes its own. The CLI
# strips it too. If either regressed, Typst would fail on rgb("##2563EB").
accent: "#2563EB"
# `headerlogo`, not `logo` — Quarto reserves `logo` and coerces it to a boolean.
headerlogo: "logo.svg"
font_head: "IBM Plex Sans"
format:
  imprint-typst: default
---

# Render smoke test

This fixture deliberately avoids Mermaid so the render needs only Quarto, pandoc,
and Typst — no headless browser. It still covers the constructs imprint restyles,
so a regression in the shared template or the Lua filter fails CI.

The H1 above duplicates the title. imprint's filter drops it; if that regressed,
the title would render twice.

> **Note.** A block quote becomes a tinted callout, and a bold `**Label.**` lead
> gives it a colored label.

## Tables

| Setting | Where | What it does |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------|
| `accent` | front matter | The single theme color for links, rules, headers |
| `cover` | front matter | Whether the title page renders |

